visualCharacteristics: Dark horizontal in-page index bar of anchor links with scroll-spy underline, a round share button with social popover, sticky pinning under the header on desktop and a bottom drawer on mobile.
contentPattern: Row 1: bulleted list of links to #heading-id anchors on the page; optional row 2: a paragraph used as the mobile drawer title.
usage: Use on long editorial or hub pages to give readers a sticky in-page table of contents with share actions.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on any long page by listing links to its section heading IDs; add light, noshare or inset to match the page style.
